# Bodhan Flex inference loader

Source: https://huggingface.co/bodhan-ai/indic-transcribe-flex
Revision: ecba9bac9013c0340fe814b336897ee51ed80be9

Python files are copied without changes from this revision. Original copyright notices and code-license declarations are retained in each file. The model's Indic Open Model License is provided in MODEL_LICENSE.md. The code derives in part from NVIDIA NeMo as noted in its source headers. Model weights and tokenizer assets are separate local downloads and are not included in the application package.
